_generation_notes.spec_status: The named multihop_scenario_spec_v2.md was not attached. This file retains its requested reference but implements the supplied brief plus the explicitly documented extensions below; full external-spec conformance is unverified.
_generation_notes.purpose: Hand-authored business cases with numerically planted feature crossings, for testing acquisition and evidence-handling mechanics. No production scorer, customer data, or deployed graph traversal was exercised.
_generation_notes.scoring_convention: Use the midpoint of each supplied action-profile interval as the centroid and equal-weight squared Euclidean distance on the seven supplied factors. No learned DK weights, cost matrix, policy gate, or live centroid state was supplied.
_generation_notes.distance_formula: distance2(x, c_a) = sum_f((x[f] - c_a[f]) ** 2); predict argmin_a distance2. Margin = second-smallest distance2 minus smallest distance2.
_generation_notes.tie_policy: The generated endpoints and all tested proper subsets have unique winners. A runner should flag ties rather than silently use input order.
_generation_notes.feature_semantics: All numeric inputs and updates are synthetic normalized scores, not observed probabilities, physical quantity fractions, or calibrated customer measurements. Amount materiality may be recomputed against explicitly documented commitment or category-headroom bases; face amount is never changed by evidence.
_generation_notes.truth_policy: Business ground truth is specified by the fictional invoice evidence and explicit policy, then synthetic feature pairs are constrained to the requested geometry. This is construction, not an independent validation of the scoring model.
_generation_notes.boundary_rule_resolution: A: at least two distinct-factor hops, every absolute shift >= .30. B: the block-specific >= .15 rule overrides the global .30 wording. C: the stated surface-resolvable, zero-read exception overrides global reversal and hop rules. D: uses the strong shift rule but has uncalibrated rho=.50 labels.
_generation_notes.example_resolution: The illustrative one-hop example is not copied because it conflicts with the multi-hop and two-factor requirements. Every non-flat case has two to four indispensable factor updates under the declared scoring convention.
_generation_notes.rho_definition: rho_planted is preserved as a requested nominal stratum only. The brief does not define a probability, correlation, population, or sampling mechanism. No realized rho, routing advantage, or accuracy is implied by its value.
_generation_notes.rho50_correction: For a uniformly random choice among five actions, expected accuracy is .20. rho=.50 alone does not establish that baseline or force a VLD policy to achieve it. Block D has one case per action but is not a validated no-information control.
_generation_notes.moderate_rho_allocation: The unspecified split within Block B is resolved as five .30 and five .50 labels, interleaved across both templates.
_generation_notes.graph_semantics: graph_path enumerates existing directed edges. requires_branch_ids and returned record locators encode acquisition dependencies. The graph alone does not enforce access. A compatible runner must enforce the acquisition contract.
_generation_notes.conditionality_limit: Content-scoped chained lookup is planted. A reference reader can resolve successive exact record-key joins from the alert entry locator and the paid evidence results. This tests prerequisite acquisition, not a calibrated noisy routing signal; rho does not alter these joins. This file does not independently establish folded or entangled boundary geometry, an adaptive-versus-breadth advantage, or a calibrated relationship between rho and retrieval performance.
_generation_notes.policies: All suppliers, identifiers, commercial terms, delegation limits and policy rules are fictional. They are explicit scenario rules, not statements of generally applicable law or procurement practice.
_generation_notes.schema_extensions: All fields requested in the brief are present. Additional underscore-prefixed evaluation metadata, acquisition fields on branches, temporal fields, graph_path, and alert.surface_evidence for flat controls are intentional. A strict additionalProperties=false consumer needs a compatibility adapter.

reproducibility.numeric_method: Linear constraints for surface/final nearest-centroid classes plus essential-hop inequalities, followed by bounded perturbation and exhaustive proper-subset checks.

_evaluation_contract.separation_rule: Never give the policy the complete scenario JSON. Serve evidence through the paid, dependency-enforcing interface. The full file is evaluator data.

random unlocked-branch retrieval with the same budget

_evaluation_contract.unresolvable_rule: When the budget or evidence is insufficient, report insufficient evidence separately from the policy action. hold_for_review is one of the five business labels and must not silently become a scoring abstention class.
_evaluation_contract.temporal_rule: All provided evidence_available_at timestamps precede alert arrival. Do not use an analyst disposition, later receipt, later supplier reply, or later payment reversal to enrich this alert.
_evaluation_contract.split_rule: Group held-out evaluation by causal template and policy structure, not random rows from five near-related variants. Keep this positive-control suite separate from real-decision estimates.
_evaluation_contract.live_scorer_rule: Rerun geometry and counterfactual checks against the actual centroids, factor order, feature normalization, DK weights and policy gates before claiming compatibility with the live S2P scorer.
_evaluation_contract.rho_followup: Define the exact quantity and observation model, generate independently seeded trials, include a true no-information routing control, and measure downstream five-action accuracy. Do not substitute the rho label for these measurements.
